Canonicalise FEBR SiBCS names to match soilKey rule outputs.

Source: R/benchmark-febr-loader.R
normalise_febr_sibcs.Rd

FEBR ships SiBCS labels in mixed legacy/modern form ("Podzolicos" for old name of Argissolos, singular vs plural, Portuguese accents). This helper folds them to the form produced by run_sibcs_key() so that benchmark accuracies can be computed without false negatives.

Usage

normalise_febr_sibcs(x, level = c("order", "subordem"))

Arguments

x

Character vector of FEBR SiBCS names.

level

One of "order" (default) or "subordem".

Value

Character vector of normalised SiBCS names; NA for labels that are out-of-scope for the comparison: any label that is not an order of SiBCS 5 after the legacy maps (old names without an entry there, "Solos ..." followed by none of them, names of other systems, text that is not a class).

Details

A label is read by its first word, with any punctuation around it dropped ("ESPODOSSOLO." is Espodossolos). Since v0.9.225 the result must be one of the 13 orders of SiBCS 5 after the legacy map; otherwise it is NA. Until then the first word came out whatever it was, so "CLASSIFICACAO ? CAMBISSOLO ..." became the class "Classificacaos", "ALISSOLO CROMICO" "Alissolos" and "LATOSOL AMARELO" "Latosois": labels no prediction can equal, which the benchmarks counted as scored profiles and as errors (631 of the 7,694 labels of the national BDsolos export, in 79 forms).

Since v0.9.226, when the first word gives no order the label is read once more as an old name: a leading "Solo" or "Solos" is set aside ("SOLO LITOLICO" is Neossolos, "SOLOS ORGANICOS" Organossolos), a hyphen separates words as a space does ("LATOSSOLO-VERMELHO", "SOLONETZ-SOLODIZADO"), and the names of .SIBCS_LEGACY_TWO_WORD_MAP ("TERRA ROXA ESTRUTURADA", "BRUNO NAO CALCICO") are looked up before those of .SIBCS_LEGACY_ORDER_MAP. A label the first word already places is read as before. At level = "subordem" an old name gives its order followed by the next word of the label, which is not a suborder of SiBCS 5 in general: the old names are for comparisons at the order level.

Since v0.9.229 the order of the name is not the last word when the label states attributes that SiBCS 5 places elsewhere: a Podzolico Vermelho-Amarelo or Vermelho-Escuro, or a label that begins with "Argissolo", that states "Eutrofico" and high-activity clay is Luvissolos, and a Cambissolo in the old form that states "Eutrofico", high-activity clay and "A chernozemico" is Chernossolos. See .sibcs_stated_order().

See also

normalise_febr_wrb, normalise_febr_usda
